about: Pollsters whose 2026 polls are known to be fabricated or otherwise unusable. Used by the poll audit only (src/model/poll_audit.py); the frozen forecast did not use this list. public_since = the date the problem was publicly reported, so the audit can tell what was knowable before the final run.

pollsters.name: Wedgewood Polls
pollsters.reason: Admitted fabricating its 2026 surveys (an 'experimental project') after FiftyPlusOne analysts compared its respondent IDs with genuine Pollfish records.
